about_the_game:
Summary
Vertical-scrolling 2D shooting game with three types of weapons


Weapons

Rapid Shot
A main weapon that can fire in rapid succession.Shoot down the enemy by creating a barrage of bullets in front of you!

Gatling Laser
Concentrate attack on locked enemies.Increase the number of simultaneous locks by raising the level.(Max. 10 locks)

Full Burst
A decisive weapon that can attack up to 16 enemies at the same time by consuming a gauge.
Can greatly increase your score.


System

Level
When the Gatling laser hits the target, a gauge is accumulated, and when it is accumulated to the maximum, the level is raised.
As the level increases, the number of simultaneous lock-ons increases, the speed of the laser increases, and the power of a laser decreases.

When level 5 or higher is reached, full burst becomes available.
Press and hold Y to switch to full burst aiming and lock on up to 16 locks.
Release Y or wait a certain amount of time before firing a full burst.

Using a full burst lowers your level by 1, but increases the multiplier of the score item you get when you destroy an enemy.


Score

The score item that appears when an enemy is destroyed by the Gatling Laser will give you a score of 100 x level.
Items that appear when you destroy an enemy with a full burst will get a score of 500 x the level x the number of simultaneous locks
Score items that appear when destroying bosses will be scored as 500 x number of hits x time remaining
